fields.label: Section Enhancer
fields.html:
<script>
(function() {
    function enhanceSections() {
        var tableDiv = document.querySelector('.child-table[data-fieldname="items"], .child-table');
        var customStyle = tableDiv ? (tableDiv.getAttribute('style') || '') : '';

        function getProp(prop) {
            var m = customStyle.match(new RegExp('(?:^|[;\\s])(?:--)?sec-' + prop + '\\s*:\\s*([^;!\\r\\n]+)', 'i'));
            return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
        }

        var bg = getProp('bg');
        var border = getProp('border');
        var badgeBg = getProp('badge-bg');
        var badgeColor = getProp('badge-color');
        var badgeDisplay = getProp('badge-display') || getProp('badge');
        var noDisplay = getProp('no-display') || getProp('no') || getProp('idx-display') || getProp('idx') || getProp('number-display') || getProp('number');
        var titleColor = getProp('title-color');
        var titleSize = getProp('title-size');
        var titleWeight = getProp('title-weight');

        if (tableDiv) {
            if (bg) tableDiv.style.setProperty('--sec-bg', bg);
            if (border) tableDiv.style.setProperty('--sec-border', border);
            if (badgeBg) tableDiv.style.setProperty('--sec-badge-bg', badgeBg);
            if (badgeColor) tableDiv.style.setProperty('--sec-badge-color', badgeColor);
            if (badgeDisplay) tableDiv.style.setProperty('--sec-badge-display', badgeDisplay);
            if (noDisplay) {
                tableDiv.style.setProperty('--sec-no-display', noDisplay);
                if (noDisplay === 'none') {
                    tableDiv.style.setProperty('--sec-title-cell-width', '100%');
                }
            }
            if (titleColor) tableDiv.style.setProperty('--sec-title-color', titleColor);
            if (titleSize) tableDiv.style.setProperty('--sec-title-size', titleSize);
            if (titleWeight) tableDiv.style.setProperty('--sec-title-weight', titleWeight);
        }

        var dynStyle = document.getElementById('emc-dynamic-section-css');
        if (!dynStyle) {
            dynStyle = document.createElement('style');
            dynStyle.id = 'emc-dynamic-section-css';
            document.head.appendChild(dynStyle);
        }
        var rules = [];
        if (bg || border) {
            var sel = 'tr.table-row:has([data-is-section="1"]), tr.table-row:has(.emc-print-section-header), tr.table-row.emc-print-section-row, tr.table-row:has([data-is-section="1"]) td, tr.table-row:has(.emc-print-section-header) td, tr.table-row.emc-print-section-row td';
            var decls = [];
            if (bg) decls.push('background-color: ' + bg + ' !important;');
            if (border) decls.push('border-top-color: ' + border + ' !important; border-bottom-color: ' + border + ' !important;');
            rules.push(sel + ' { ' + decls.join(' ') + ' }');
        }
        if (noDisplay) {
            rules.push('tr.table-row:has([data-is-section="1"]) td.column-value[data-fieldname="idx"], tr.table-row:has(.emc-print-section-header) td.column-value[data-fieldname="idx"], tr.table-row.emc-print-section-row td.column-value[data-fieldname="idx"] { display: ' + noDisplay + ' !important; }');
            if (noDisplay === 'none') {
                rules.push('tr.table-row:has([data-is-section="1"]) td.column-value[data-fieldname="item_name"], tr.table-row:has(.emc-print-section-header) td.column-value[data-fieldname="item_name"], tr.table-row.emc-print-section-row td.column-value[data-fieldname="item_name"] { width: 100% !important; max-width: none !important; }');
            }
        }
        var bDecls = [];
        if (badgeBg) bDecls.push('background-color: ' + badgeBg + ' !important;');
        if (badgeColor) bDecls.push('color: ' + badgeColor + ' !important;');
        if (badgeDisplay) bDecls.push('display: ' + badgeDisplay + ' !important;');
        if (bDecls.length) rules.push('.emc-print-section-badge { ' + bDecls.join(' ') + ' }');

        var tDecls = [];
        if (titleColor) tDecls.push('color: ' + titleColor + ' !important;');
        if (titleSize) tDecls.push('font-size: ' + titleSize + ' !important;');
        if (titleWeight) tDecls.push('font-weight: ' + titleWeight + ' !important;');
        if (tDecls.length) rules.push('.emc-print-section-title { ' + tDecls.join(' ') + ' }');

        if (rules.length) {
            dynStyle.textContent = rules.join('\n');
        }

        var headers = document.querySelectorAll('.emc-print-section-header, [data-is-section="1"]');
        headers.forEach(function(h) {
            var row = h.closest('tr');
            if (row && !row.classList.contains('emc-print-section-row')) {
                row.classList.add('emc-print-section-row');
                var cells = row.querySelectorAll('td.column-value');
                var idxCell = row.querySelector('td.column-value[data-fieldname="idx"]');
                var itemCell = row.querySelector('td.column-value[data-fieldname="item_name"]');
                var hideNo = (noDisplay === 'none');
                if (hideNo && idxCell) {
                    idxCell.style.display = 'none';
                }
                if (itemCell && cells.length > 1) {
                    itemCell.colSpan = hideNo ? cells.length : (cells.length - 1);
                }
                cells.forEach(function(cell) {
                    var fn = cell.getAttribute('data-fieldname');
                    if (fn !== 'item_name' && fn !== 'section_title' && (hideNo || fn !== 'idx')) {
                        cell.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', enhanceSections);
    } else {
        enhanceSections();
    }
    setTimeout(enhanceSections, 50);
    setTimeout(enhanceSections, 200);
})();
</script>
